capabilities: imports DingTalk AI Minutes summaries, keywords, action items, and optional transcripts
names notes by actual meeting start date
syncs manually, on startup, or on a schedule
preserves existing notes when the transcript API is unavailable
writes frontmatter with source task UUID and meeting start time
extras: Desktop-only because it invokes a local CLI; includes a data-access and privacy section stating the plugin stores no DingTalk credentials and has no telemetry. Installed via manual file download rather than the community plugin catalog.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring DingTalk AI Minutes recordings' summaries and transcripts into a vault as notes.

requires.name: DingTalk account with AI Minutes access

summary: Meeting-minutes importer that pulls DingTalk AI Minutes (summaries, keywords, action items, transcripts) into a vault as Markdown notes via the local dws CLI.
